posts.title: i took back the assistant button
posts.description: the mic button on my mi tv remote only talks to google. with claude code i made it open my own voice search instead. no root, and android tried hard to stop me.

posts.title: i cleaned up my tv
posts.description: my mi tv came with tracking, ads, and a laggy home screen. i removed 29 apps over wifi in about ten minutes. no root needed.

posts.title: fast is not the skill anymore
posts.description: the model is fast. that question is settled. the skill now is knowing the output is wrong and being able to say why.
